svg.title: Divers' Yard — Six pontoon stations beneath a diving boom
svg.desc: Six dry training stations surround a shallow drill basin. Tethered pontoons, rope ladders and a high gong deck offer a playful route without a swimming prerequisite.
svg.text: Six pontoon stations beneath a diving boom
Six dry training stations surround a shallow drill basin. Tethered pontoons, rope ladders and a high gong deck
offer a playful route without a swimming prerequisite.
